incidents.name: GMT7 helper public trading functions
incidents.notes: The unverified GMT7 helper holds GMT7 balances and router approvals and exposes its buy/sell functions publicly, so the attacker forced it to buy GMT7 and then repeatedly sell the helper's GMT7 to the GMT7/USDT pair while routing the USDT output to itself.

sources.ref: onchain review: victim 0x9AD90eeaB3CAff64A762Cb40387Ee1BB18bd31E3 created 2025-02-07T12:45:18Z by 0x617e51515a024575a807cb85b6dcc49c783d78a7, which is not the attack-tx sender 0x0a4125690753b6cc82cadbca0f0899eb2025acb0; 0 EIP-1967 Upgraded events on the victim before the incident; code age measured from deployment (onchain). 16.75 BNB x $615.01/BNB at the incident timestamp 1739073552 (DefiLlama coingecko:binancecoin) = $10,301.
